States China exports more cars than any other nation, but specifies this is primarily gas-powered cars currently, and EV export markets are developing.
Notes that the Chinese electric car supply chain invested more overseas than domestically, but does not provide specific production numbers for other countries.
States that China's automotive industry produced close to 30% of the nearly 80m vehicles made worldwide in 2024, indicating a large overall vehicle manufacturing base.
